Topics in detail

Beneath the six main fields, each paper also carries a finer SciBERT research-area label for 2001–2025.

The 15 most common research-area labels among 1,328 papers. SciBERT is a language model trained on scientific text; it reads each paper's title and abstract and assigns a single subject label. The largest label here is Electrical and Electronic Engineering at 13.3% of the corpus.

How it reads

Reading difficulty scored on 1,034 papers' prose (equations, tables and reference lists removed) using the Flesch–Kincaid grade.

Distribution of reading grade. Median 14.5; 82% read at college level or harder.
